```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  select(artist, track, date.entered, wk1:wk4) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarize(
    earliest_date = min(date.entered),
    latest_date = max(date.entered)
  )
```

```{r}
wk1_data <- billboard |>
  select(wk1) |>
  drop_na()

wk1_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wk1)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(fill = after_stat(x)),
    binwidth = 5,
    boundary = 0,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#fce4ec", "#f48fb1", "#ec407a", "#ad1457"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Week 1 Billboard rankings",
    subtitle = paste("Number of values used:", nrow(wk1_data)),
    x = "Week 1 ranking",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#ad1457", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#c2185b")
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  summarize(
    present = sum(!is.na(rank)),
    missing = sum(is.na(rank)),
    .by = week
  )
```

```{r}
song_changes <- billboard |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(wk6) ~ "missing by week 6",
      wk6 < wk1  ~ "improved",
      wk6 == wk1 ~ "stayed the same",
      wk6 > wk1  ~ "got worse"
    )
  )

# Count songs by status
song_changes |>
  count(status)

# Median rank change for songs present in both weeks (wk1 - wk6)
song_changes |>
  filter(!is.na(wk6)) |>
  summarize(
    median_rank_change = median(wk1 - wk6)
  )
```

```{r}
billboard_longer <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = parse_number(week)
  )

billboard_longer |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Song Rankings Over Time",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
billboard_longer |>
  summarize(
    reentered = any(diff(week) > 1),
    .by = c(artist, track)
  ) |>
  count(reentered)
```

```{r}
song_summary <- billboard_longer |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .by = c(artist, track)
  )

# Print first few rows of summary
head(song_summary)

# Notable top-10 songs
bind_rows(
  song_summary |> filter(best_rank == 1) |> slice_min(first_week_best, n = 1) |> mutate(notable = "Fastest to #1"),
  song_summary |> filter(best_rank == 1) |> slice_max(first_week_best, n = 1) |> mutate(notable = "Slowest to #1"),
  song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10) |> slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1) |> mutate(notable = "Longest run (Top 10)")
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_best, total_weeks)
```

```{r}
top10_data <- billboard_longer |>
  semi_join(song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10), by = c("artist", "track"))

notable_data <- top10_data |>
  filter(
    (artist == "Madonna" & track == "Music") |
    (artist == "Lonestar" & track == "Amazed") |
    (artist == "Creed" & track == "Higher")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    song_label = paste0(artist, " - \"", track, "\"")
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = top10_data,
    aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track),
    color = "gray80",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = notable_data,
    aes(x = week, y = rank, color = song_label),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Top-10 Billboard Song Rankings Over Time",
    subtitle = "Three notable songs highlighted against all top-10 tracks",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank",
    color = "Notable song"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
